receipt.public_excerpt: Replit was valued at just over $1 billion in 2023 after it raised $97.4 million. The company said its annualized revenue rose to $150 million from $2.8 million in less than a year.

evidence_items.explanation: A nearly tripled valuation and revenue growth from $2.8M to $150M annualised in under a year do not fit 'floundering, struggling to stay alive' for one of the leading AI startups.
